Title: Cheese Pancakes
Ingredients:
1. 1 cup 5% quark (soft white cheese)
2. 2 eggs
3. ½ cup all-purpose flour
4. 2 tbsp silan (date syrup)
5. 1 cup heavy cream
6. 4 petit beurre biscuits
Steps:
1. Mix the quark with the eggs and flour until you have a thick batter.
2. Fry spoonfuls of the batter in a greased skillet until golden on both sides.
3. Whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
4. Serve with the whipped cream, crumbled biscuits, and silan.
